review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 原题001/002/003/004/007及新明确补答008已实施：当前永沐曝、减抗、眷颂、唱词减伤及破黯穿穹均为自身与当前对手行为；仅真实换宠/下场/场下回复独立延期。
review.singleBehavior: 对方执行最终概率不高于50%的异常效果时附一层曝，原始0不执行、封零仍计执行；不高于50%的异常抗性减20个百分点钳零、死亡效果封锁消逝。当前自身回初按唱词减红，行动末达到4句消耗并按不同种数各50远古光属性直伤，仅计算克制；只在敌原有曝时得4号位对应唱词。结束后己方实际用招且敌未用、当回未得唱词时授技能对应唱词，非四首无对应。

success.name: 4853真实2038唱词回初快照减红每句15%，不随本回合得词改变且不减固粉真
4853/2382曝先制必中与2384烧伤转焚烬保留回合，永沐低概率执行即曝含失败概率并阻死亡
4853真实曝击败消逝先于复活及死亡技能回复，砥砺真实伤害后80%回复沿公共机制
success.assertion:
const a=make({move:38206,index:-1,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.statusProbability(50);},()=>turn(a));a.fighters[1].hp=1;timer(a,1,'死亡时技能回复');a.fighters[1].soulState.rebirth2243={armed:true};turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stats.maxHp,0);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].soulState.vanished,true);assert.equal(a.vanishedCount,1);assert.equal(a.vanishEvents.length,1);
 const b=make({...row(2371),hp:1000});turn(b);b.moveDefinitions[key(38213)].operations=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100,'砥砺公共真伤测试','true');},()=>turn(b,38213));assert.equal(b.fighters[0].hp,980);assert.equal(sum(b,'true',1),100);

success.name: 4853/458先手普通红回血，残1HP按已答完整红回血，后手不回，2340先附后解除自身异常且免疫失败仍解除
4853真实3012原生384的50%烧伤与30%麻痹，失败也曝且随机状态、伤害及PP与无观察方一致
4853真实3066智取荆州164受击监听50%，成功失败均曝，命中前未授监听不观察
4853真实3025原生389动态攻击20%应曝、属性80%不曝，真实技能类型控制资格
4853真实3737原生1015回初50%对敌或自身附烧伤都属对方执行，候选选择与时长随机不冒充低概率
4853真实五星表内高热与火热特性8%异常执行失败也曝，非异常特性不因低概率附曝
success.assertion:
const C=E.CHARACTERISTICS,o={id:3066,ids:[16076,19415,24805,19416,19417],move:16076,native:false};for(const group of[24,45]){const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=battle({...o,seed});a.moveDefinitions[key(16076)].operations=[];a.moveDefinitions[key(38213)].operations=[];a.fighters[1].build.characteristic=C.normalize({groupId:group,star:5});go(a,16076,38213);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].soulState.exposure4853);assert.ok(a.ailmentExecutions4853.some(e=>e.actorSide===1&&e.chance===8));seen.add(!!a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);}
 const b=battle(o);b.moveDefinitions[key(16076)].operations=[];b.fighters[1].build.characteristic=C.normalize({groupId:C.groups.find(g=>g.name==='会心').id,star:5});go(b,16076);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].soulState.exposure4853,undefined);

success.name: 4853已答眷颂：结束后才得对应唱词，当回合已得不再授，非四首无唱词且未用不授
4853已答破黯穿穹：只按不同唱词与远古光克制附属性直伤，防御减伤盾罩免伤及倍率均不参与，不额外扣PP
4853补答008：仅原本已有曝才得四号位唱词，首次附曝不授，四号位非四首不授，曝只有一层
4853已答曝减抗：减20个百分点、零及负值钳零且只一层，18抗实战不能抵抗，超过50抗不变
success.assertion:
for(const [raw,expected]of [[-.1,0],[0,0],[.18,0],[.4,.2],[.5,.3],[.51,.51]]){const s=make({move:38206,index:-1});ability.expose({a:s.fighters[0],t:s.fighters[1]});assert.ok(Math.abs(ability.resistance(s.fighters[1],raw)-expected)<1e-12);ability.expose({a:s.fighters[0],t:s.fighters[1]});assert.ok(Math.abs(ability.resistance(s.fighters[1],raw)-expected)<1e-12);}
 const baselineResults=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++){for(const exposed of [false,true]){const s=make({move:38206,index:-1,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});s.fighters[1].build.resistance.slots=[{name:'中毒',chance:18}];if(exposed)ability.expose({a:s.fighters[0],t:s.fighters[1]});let applied;observe((event,c)=>{if(event==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)applied=c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2);},()=>turn(s,38206,20309));if(exposed){assert.equal(applied,true);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']);}else baselineResults.add(applied);}}assert.deepEqual(baselineResults,new Set([false,true]));

success.name: 4853已答永沐：最终概率跨50判资格，原始零不执行，寒月或亮封零仍曝且不强行附异常

success.assertion:
for(const groupId of [24,45])for(const mode of ['bright','moon','turbulence']){const s=make({move:38213,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:opponent,enemyLoadout:ids});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,2038);s.moveDefinitions[key(special)].operations=[];s.fighters[1].build.characteristic=E.CHARACTERISTICS.normalize({groupId,star:5});
 assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].soulState.exposure4853,mode!=='turbulence',groupId+'/'+mode);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],mode==='turbulence',groupId+'/'+mode);
